payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_revert.py::test_revert_leaves_out_exactly_the_declared_renames_census_accepts stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The new name counted as collected at head when a head name starts with it, so the clause names a new name head never collected.' applied to saffron/gates/core/revert.py as an edit. The claim was "`revert_gate` takes a spec's declared `renames` as a keyword that defaults to none. It accepts a pair by `census`'s own rule: the old name is collected at base and absent at head, and the new name is collected at head and absent at base. Names are compared whole, never by prefix, substring or the text after the last `::`. An accepted pair's new name leaves the set of tests the diff adds before the exempt names are taken from it, so `run_tests` is never handed it unless a criterion names it as its witness. A renamed criterion witness is judged as before, and a renamed `preserves` witness stays out as before. One clause names each new name the rule left out, once each, and no other pair's new name. It rides the summaries that carry the exempt names: a `pass`, a `fail`, and a `skip` with no new test left to judge. An accepted new name that is also exempt is named by that clause and not by the exempt clause. In one call that ends `pass`, the witness drives eleven pairs: one accepted, one whose old name stays at head, one whose old name was never collected, one whose new name was already collected at base, one whose new name head does not collect, one accepted whose new name a criterion names, one accepted whose new name a `preserves` criterion names, one whose old name matches a base name only after the last `::`, one whose old name is a prefix of a base name and of no head name, one whose new name is a prefix of a head name only, and one accepted whose new name is exempt. Two undeclared new tests sit beside them: one added on its own, and the head name the new-name prefix pair leaves. It asserts the exact subset handed to `run_tests`, which new names the summary holds, and that no exempt clause appears. Over two accepted renames, one a criterion's witness, both passing with the source reverted, it asserts a `fail` naming the witness alone, whose summary names the other. With the keyword omitted, the same input fails both names. With four accepted non-witness pairs alone, one new name collected twice at head, the gate skips as a diff that adds no new test, and its summary names each of the four new names exactly once.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
